submission.justification: Sensor-T2 gives the best simulated unirradiated resolution at every thickness I tried. At 50, 100, 150 and 200 um it gave 7.0, 6.2, 6.1 and 6.0 um. Sensor-T3 gave 15.1 um at 100 um. The 2025 summary has T1 at 9.0 um and T3 at 14.0 um for 150 um. I chose 150 um because it sits on the flat part of the resolution curve. Going to 200 um gains only about 0.07 um, and a thicker sensor probably adds material and leakage current. I did not check that. WARNING: the hard requirement of at least 97% hit efficiency at 2e16 neq/cm^2 is unverified. No project document gives irradiated efficiency data for any candidate, and the simulation tool only models unirradiated sensors. This recommendation is therefore provisional. Before it is adopted, T2 needs irradiated-efficiency data, from test-beam measurements or a radiation-damage simulation. T2's thin pitch and signal sharing may reduce charge per pixel after irradiation. T1 or T3 (3D, which is generally radiation-hard) may be needed as a fallback.

requirements.evidence: Sensor-T2 simulated at 6.0-7.0 um over 50-200 um, versus 9.0 um for T1 (2025, 150 um) and 14-15 um for T3. At 150 um, T2 gave 6.09 um.
No irradiated efficiency data in any document, and the simulation covers only unirradiated sensors. It cannot be confirmed for T2 at any thickness.

requirements.requirement: Technology must be one of the three in candidate_specs.md
